name: decaid-system
description: Decentralized Academic Identity and Credential Risk Assessment System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,ai,auth "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run ai-service" "npm run auth-service"

scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../ai-service && python -m pytest
